Find matching Seymour neurons for octo neurons

octo_nblast_seymour.Rd

Moves Seymour neurons into octo space with the registration, then compares them with octo skeletons by NBLAST (shape and position) and lists the best matches for each octo neuron. Use the result to fill seymour_match_id in the seed table.

Usage

octo_nblast_seymour(
  octo,
  seymour,
  top = 5,
  reg = seymour_octo_reg(),
  resample = 1,
  k = 5
)

Arguments

octo

octo skeletons from octo_skeletonize(), or root IDs

seymour

Seymour neurons in Seymour space, e.g. from read_seymour_neurons()

top

number of matches listed per octo neuron

reg

registration, see seymour_octo_reg()

resample, k

dotprops settings (µm and neighbours)

Value

data.frame with octo_id, octo annotations, rank, seymour_id, seymour_name, score (mean of both directions), score_fwd, score_rev. The full score matrix is in attr(, "scores").

Details

NBLAST scores range up to 1 (identical). The mean of both directions is used for ranking. Keep the registration error (a few µm) in mind: compare candidates that share a lineage or neuropil, and check matches by eye.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
sey <- read_seymour_neurons("annotation:^MBON$", conn = conn)
m <- octo_nblast_seymour(octo_find_ids("^MBON"), sey)
m[m$rank == 1, c("octo_id", "cell_type", "seymour_name", "score")]
} # }
